book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MATEO

content: Yal Comam Jesús tato chiuchcꞌalaxayo yatut Comam Dios
Lahwi tuꞌ, yelti Comam Jesús yul yatut Comam Dios. Hayet lan̈an yelti Comam tuꞌ xin ishitzico ebnaj iscuywom Comam iscꞌatan̈, yichico ebnaj isyeni huntekꞌan teꞌ n̈a yetbi isba yeb yatut Comam tuꞌ.
Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, huntekꞌan cheyil tiꞌ chiapni istzꞌayical bay chiuchcꞌalaxtoj. Machi hunu chꞌen chꞌen latzꞌbil tiꞌ chican yiban̈ yet chꞌenal,
ẍi Comam tet ebnaj.
Huntekꞌan yechel chu yet chihul islahobal tzꞌayic

Lahwi tuꞌ isto Comam Jesús yin̈ istzalanil won̈an Olivo, yay tzꞌon̈no Comam bey tuꞌ, ishitzico ebnaj iscuywom Comam iscꞌatan̈. Hayet ischuquil ebnaj yeb Comam tuꞌ iskꞌamben ebnaj tet Comam: —Mamin, hal jetan̈, ¿bakꞌin chu huntekꞌan maxawal tuꞌ, yeb baytet huntekꞌan yechel chisye isba yet toxa chaẍhuli yeb yin̈ yet chilahwi yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ? ẍi ebnaj.
Yichico Comam yalni tet ebnaj: —Caw cheyil heba, machojab mac chexakꞌni subchahoj.
Yuto txꞌiꞌal ebnaj chuli cat isbalnico ebnaj inbihan yin̈, cat yalni: “Hanintiꞌan Cristo inan,” ẍi ebnaj. Caw xin txꞌiꞌal mac chisubcha yu ebnaj.
Cheyaben yichican̈ howal bey tiꞌ, yeb yul huntekꞌanxa con̈ob. Yajaꞌ mach chexxiwi yuto yilal yul huntekꞌan tuꞌ, yaj maẍto istan̈balo yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ.

Chakꞌlecan̈ howal ej txꞌotxꞌ nimeta con̈ob yeb huntekꞌanxa txꞌotxꞌ nimeta con̈ob, cat yanipaxico howal huneꞌ con̈ob yin̈ huneꞌxa con̈ob. Caw txꞌiꞌal howal yeb yabil chuli, chulpaxo wahil yeb chixcab yul hunun con̈ob.
Yajaꞌ yichebaniln̈e isyaꞌilal ye huntekꞌan tuꞌ.
Hex tiꞌ, chexilaxto sata ebnaj yahaw con̈ob yu yakꞌlax ecꞌoyaꞌ heyanma, cat xin quexispotxꞌni camo ebnaj. Sunil anma yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ chexcajni yuto tzujanex wintajan.
Yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ, txꞌiꞌal mac chiyilo yanma yin̈ Comam Dios. Chioc ishowal anma yin̈ hunun, cat ishobnican̈ anma lekꞌtiꞌal yin̈ hunun.
Txꞌiꞌal ebnaj chalico isba ischejabo Comam Dios, caw xin txꞌiꞌal mac chisubcha yu ebnaj.
Caw chiahcan̈ anma iswatxꞌen istxꞌojal, yuxin matxa xahano chil anma yet anmahil.
Haꞌ mac chitecha yu masanto yin̈ islahobal, haꞌ chicolchahi.
Yajaꞌ wal Tzotiꞌ cꞌul yin̈ tzet chu yoc anma yul iskꞌab Comam Dios, yilal ispujbalaxicꞌo yul hunun con̈ob yun̈e yohtan̈encanilo anma, lahwi tuꞌ cat yul islahobal tzꞌayic.
Tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yu huneꞌ ischejab Comam Dios chiyij Daniel yin̈ huneꞌ naj chihul etanoto yatut Comam Dios yu istxꞌojal chiswatxꞌe naj. Mac chiilni huneꞌ tiꞌ istxumabiloj.
Yuxin maquex ayexicꞌo yul con̈ob Judea tiꞌ yet chiyuni huneꞌ tuꞌ yilal heyelcan̈ cat heto iswiꞌla witz.
Haꞌ mac ayahto yiban̈ yacꞌalil yatut, matxa chiayti yikꞌalti hunu tzet ye tuꞌ yul yatut, to beh yelcan̈.
Wal mac ayto xol ismunil xin, matxa chimeltzo yikꞌalti xil iskꞌap yul yatut.
¡Cꞌanchꞌan ebix ix ayxa tzet yehi, yeb ebix chi-to-txutxwi niẍte yunin yet chiyuni huneꞌ tuꞌ!
Yuxin kꞌanwe tet Comam Dios, haxinwal machojab yin̈ n̈abil chu huneꞌ tuꞌ, machojabpaxo yin̈ istzꞌayical xewilal chiyuhi.
Yuto huneꞌ isyaꞌtajil chul yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ, caw nanxa islowi, maẍto hunelo chu yichitax iswatxꞌi yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, matxa bakꞌinal chupaxoj yet chilahwi yecꞌcanoj.
Yajaꞌ tato mach chiscꞌotzba Comam Dios yoj huneꞌ tiempo tuꞌ, machim hunu mac chicolchahi. Wal xin chiscꞌotzba Comam yu iscolni macta sicꞌbilxa yu.
Yuxin ta ay mac chihalni teyet: “Ay naj Cristo bey tiꞌ, lah,” maca “ay naj Cristo bey tuꞌ, lah,” ta ẍi, mach cheyayto yul heyanma.

Yuto ay ebnaj chisbalico isba Cristohal, yeb ay ebnaj chalico isba ischejabo Comam Dios. Chisye ebnaj huntekꞌan yechel yeb cꞌaybalcꞌule yun̈e issubcha anma yu ebnaj. Etza xin chisubchapaxo mac sicꞌbilxa yu Comam Dios yu ebnaj.
Wal xin, ayto chiwalnicanojan huntekꞌan tiꞌ teyet.
Yuxin ta ay mac chihalni teyet: “As ilwej, ay naj Cristo bey txꞌotxꞌ desierto,” ta ẍi, mach chextohi. Maca ta chihallax teyet: “Ewan ye naj bey tiꞌ, lah,” ta ẍi, mach cheyayto yul heyanma.
Yuto hacaꞌ jilni isjebla cꞌuh bay chiahilo tzꞌayic, cat isjeplapaxo bay chito tzꞌayic, hac tuꞌ chu wulan Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios.
Haꞌticꞌa bay ayayo isnimanil hunu camom, haꞌ tuꞌ chiscutxba isba noꞌ usmij, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj iscuywom.
Yin̈ tzet chu yul Comam Jesucristo

Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús: —Chin̈elahwi yecꞌto huntekꞌan nimeta isyaꞌtajil tuꞌ, cat iskꞌejholilo yoj tzꞌayic, wal ixahaw matxa chimujli, cat istitcꞌay txꞌumel ay satcan̈, cat xin istzicobtan̈elax sunil tzet ay yip yul satcan̈.

Lahwi tuꞌ cat isyenican̈ isba yechel wulbalan yul satcan̈, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios. Wal anma ay yul hunun con̈ob yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, chixiwcan̈ cat yoc okꞌoj yet chiyilni wulan xol moyan. Chinhulan yeb iskꞌakꞌal wipan.

Hayet chiokꞌ chꞌen trompeta yin̈ caw ip, chinchejnicojan ebnaj ángel iscutxbaco sunil macta sicꞌbilxa wuhan yul yiban̈kꞌinal. Caw xin sunil yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal chiecꞌ ebnaj iscutxbacan̈ anma sicꞌbilxa tuꞌ.
Txumwecꞌanab yin̈ teꞌ higuera, hayet chiyaxbilo ischon iskꞌab teꞌ cat yelilo niẍte xaj teꞌ, cheyohtan̈eloj ta toxa chioc haꞌ n̈ab.
Hacpax tuꞌ xin yet cheyilni yijni isba sunil tzet chiwaltiꞌan, cheyohtan̈eloj tato cawilxa wetijan, hacaꞌ hunu mac lin̈anxaco sat pulta.
Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, sunil huntekꞌan tiꞌ chij isba yalan̈to maẍto chicam huntekꞌan anma ayicꞌo yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal tiꞌ.
Haꞌ satcan̈ yeb txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ chitan̈iloj, yajaꞌ wal intzotiꞌan xin machi ecꞌto yet yijni isba tzet chala.
Yajaꞌ wal yin̈ tzet tzꞌayical yeb tzet orahil chinhultuꞌan, machi mac ohtan̈e, nitam ebnaj ángel ay satcan̈. Mach wohtapaxojan hanin Iscꞌahol Comam Dios intiꞌan, walxinto han̈cꞌan̈e Inmaman ohtan̈e.
Hacaꞌ yu anma yin̈ istiempohal naj Noé, hac tuꞌ chu anma yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal yet chinhulan, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios.
Yuto yet yalan̈to maẍto chihul haꞌ niman yaxn̈ab, caw matzet chal iscꞌul anma yin̈ tzet yal naj Noé, caw xin han̈e waꞌoj yeb ismohyi ayco yin̈ iscꞌul masanto yet yocto naj Noé yul teꞌ barco.

Hayet tona nahul ay anma tuꞌ, yul huneꞌ niman yaxn̈ab yiban̈, istan̈ilo anma sunil. Hacaꞌ yu anma yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ, hac tuꞌ chu anma yet chinhul lemnahan, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios.
Kꞌinalo ta ay cawan̈o ebnaj winaj huneꞌn̈e chimunlahi yet chiyuni huneꞌ tuꞌ, huneꞌ naj chiilaxtoj, huneꞌxa naj xin chicancanoj.
Yeb xin ta ay cawan̈ ebix huneꞌn̈e lan̈an iscawni, huneꞌ ix chiilaxtoj huneꞌxa ix chicancanoj.
Caw majwahan̈wej, yuto mach heyohtajo tzet tzꞌayical chinhulan, hanin Heyahaw intiꞌan.
Kꞌinalo ta yohta hunu naj yahaw n̈a tzet orahil chul hunu naj elkꞌom yin̈ akꞌbalil, chimyilo naj iswayan̈. Hac tuꞌ xin mach chiocto naj elkꞌom tuꞌ yelkꞌalti tzet ay naj.
Haꞌ quexpax tuꞌ hex tiꞌ, helan cheyute heba, yuto yet matxa nano heyu cat wul lemnahan, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, ẍi Comam Jesús.
Naj chejab yijem yeb naj mach yijemoj
Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús: —Kꞌinalo ta ay hunu naj yahaw munil ay haywan̈o ischejab, ham naj yijem yeb caw helan chacano naj seleloj yu yakꞌni tzet chislo ebnaj ismunlawom yet chicꞌayayoj.
Sakꞌal yet naj chejab ta lan̈an isyijen naj tzet halbilcano tet yet chiapni naj yahaw tuꞌ.
Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, naj yahaw munil tuꞌ chaco naj naj yijem tuꞌ yahawo yin̈ sunil tzet aya.
Yajaꞌ ta mach cꞌuluj chute isba naj, cat yoc naj yalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Yaꞌ wahawtuꞌan, ¿bakꞌintam chul yaꞌ?” ta ẍi naj.
Cat yoc naj ismakꞌni ebnaj chejab tuꞌ, cat yoc naj waꞌoj yeb xin ucꞌu xol ebnaj ucꞌum teꞌ.
Haxa yet istzꞌayical mach echmabilo yahaw naj tuꞌ yu, hayet tohna nahul ay naj cat yul lemna yahaw naj tuꞌ.
Hac tuꞌ xin chiakꞌlax ecꞌoyaꞌ yanma naj yu naj yahaw tuꞌ, hacaꞌ yakꞌlax ecꞌoyaꞌ yanma huntekꞌan ebnaj chal isba cꞌulal. Haꞌ tuꞌ xin chiokꞌ naj cat isn̈etxꞌla yeh naj yu isyaꞌtajil, ẍi Comam.

footnotes.text: Yij isba huneꞌ tiꞌ yu ebnaj soldado romano yin̈ habil 70 D.C
